disputed_verses.KJV 1CH 6:37: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

first_reader_said: 1CH 6:37: Tahath son of Assir son of Ebiasaph holds the same place as in 6:23-24, and both records are son of Assir.

why: The ancestry in 1CH 6:37—Tahath, Assir, Ebiasaph, Korah—matches A's family line in 1CH 6:23–24. B repeats this same identification, and its description of Tahath as Zephaniah's father does not conflict with his also having Uriel as a son in 1CH 6:24. A preserves the fuller family ties and both verse references.
